brief:
Al Jazeera English examined how US midterm election results could affect conflicts in Iran, Gaza, and Ukraine, noting that despite Democratic gains, the party lacks the two-thirds majority required to override a presidential veto or pass legislation independently.

The outcome leaves Democrats with expanded congressional power but constrained ability to shape foreign policy unilaterally on these fronts without Republican support.
dek: Despite wins, Democrats lack the two-thirds majority needed to overturn a presidential veto and push through a law.
title: Democrats gain seats but fall short of veto-proof majority in midterms
